name: Cox's Bazar
shortDescription: Bangladesh's celebrated Bay of Bengal beach resort, with Laboni, Sugandha, Kolatoli, Inani and Himchari nearby.
description: Cox's Bazar is a coastal resort town in southeastern Bangladesh. Its wide sandy beach, seafood, sunsets and nearby Inani and Himchari make it suitable for a two- or three-day trip.

routeMap.fromChattogram: Use a direct coach from Dampara or AK Khan, or a scheduled Chattogram-Cox's Bazar train.

howToGo: From Chattogram take a direct coach or scheduled train; use CNG auto-rickshaws, e-rickshaws or reserved cars within the resort area.

reviews.author: Nusrat A.
reviews.comment: Early morning walks and sunset were the highlights.

safetyTips: Obey water-safety notices and avoid rough surf.
Keep valuables secure in crowded beach areas.

name: Bandarban: Devotakhum & Nilachal
shortDescription: Nilachal's panoramic viewpoint and Devotakhum's remote boat-and-trek experience in the Bandarban hills.
description: Nilachal is a hilltop viewpoint close to Bandarban town. Devotakhum is a narrow rocky water channel in the Ruma-Thanchi region, generally requiring approved local transport, boat travel and a local guide.

routeMap.fromChattogram: Take a direct bus to Bandarban town. Use a Chander Gari or jeep for Nilachal; confirm current authority permission and approved guide arrangements before Devotakhum.

howToGo: Reach Bandarban town by bus. Visit Nilachal with a local vehicle. For Devotakhum, verify current route restrictions and travel only with an approved local guide.

reviews.author: Tanmoy S.
reviews.comment: Nilachal was easy to reach; Devotakhum needed careful local planning.

safetyTips: Confirm permission requirements before remote travel.
Use a guide, grippy footwear and avoid trails in heavy rain.

name: Khagrachari: Sajek Valley
shortDescription: A highland valley known for cloud-covered mornings, views and indigenous community culture.
description: Sajek Valley is in Baghaichhari Upazila of Rangamati District but is commonly reached via Khagrachari. Visitors use local jeeps for the hill road and should respect community privacy and local travel instructions.

routeMap.fromChattogram: Travel by bus to Khagrachari, then take a reserved registered jeep or Chander Gari to Sajek.

howToGo: Book a Khagrachari-bound bus, then share a registered jeep where possible. Book cottages in advance and confirm current hill-road procedures.

reviews.author: Imran H.
reviews.comment: The sunrise clouds were worth the long jeep ride.

safetyTips: Use registered vehicles and follow local timing instructions.
Ask before photographing people or private homes.

name: Patenga Sea Beach
shortDescription: A lively waterfront at the Karnaphuli River estuary, ideal for an easy Chattogram sunset outing.
description: Patenga Sea Beach is a popular public waterfront near Shah Amanat International Airport. It is known for sea breezes, food stalls, sunsets and views of ships near the river mouth.
bestTime: Late afternoon, especially November to February

routeMap.fromChattogram: Use city buses, CNG auto-rickshaws, ride-share or a reserved car toward Patenga via Airport Road.

howToGo: Travel along Airport Road and allow extra time for traffic. Arrange a registered return vehicle before staying after dark.

reviews.author: Sabbir M.
reviews.comment: A lively, simple sunset stop with plenty of snacks.

safetyTips: Do not enter unsafe water or climb barriers.
Keep children close in crowded areas.

name: Foy's Lake
shortDescription: A man-made lake and recreation area surrounded by Chattogram's green hills.
description: Foy's Lake is a scenic artificial lake created during the British period and associated with a family recreation complex, boat rides and hill-and-water views.
bestTime: November to March or a clear late afternoon
recommendedDuration: Half day to a full day

routeMap.fromChattogram: Travel from GEC, Tigerpass or central Chattogram by CNG, ride-share or local transport toward Foy's Lake.

howToGo: Use a CNG, ride-share or car from the city centre and confirm the recreation complex's opening hours and ticket choices.

reviews.author: Rumana N.
reviews.comment: A refreshing city escape with pleasant lake views.

safetyTips: Supervise children near water and rides.
Keep ticket stubs until you leave.

name: Ethnological Museum
shortDescription: A museum in Agrabad presenting the cultural heritage of Bangladesh's ethnic communities.
description: The Ethnological Museum in Agrabad, Chattogram displays objects connected with ethnic communities of Bangladesh, including communities of the Chittagong Hill Tracts.

routeMap.fromChattogram: Reach Agrabad by city bus, CNG, ride-share or car.
routeMap.distance: About 3 km from Chattogram Railway Station

howToGo: Travel to Agrabad and confirm current opening days, entry fees and photography rules before visiting.

reviews.author: Sadia L.
reviews.comment: A quiet, informative stop for understanding regional cultural diversity.

safetyTips: Do not touch artifacts unless permitted.

name: Sitakunda Hill
shortDescription: A hilly coastal area north of Chattogram, known for Chandranath trails, waterfalls and forest.
description: Sitakunda offers hill hikes, including the Chandranath area, plus seasonal waterfall routes. Trail difficulty and safety change with weather, especially in monsoon.

routeMap.fromChattogram: Take a Dhaka-bound bus, local bus or an appropriate train to Sitakunda; then use local CNG transport to the trail approach.

howToGo: Travel north to Sitakunda, start hiking early, check conditions locally and return before dark.

reviews.author: Jubayer R.
reviews.comment: A rewarding hike when started before the midday heat.

safetyTips: Wear grippy shoes and carry water.
Avoid unfamiliar trails after dark or in heavy rain.

name: Anderkillah Shahi Jame Mosque
shortDescription: A historic Mughal-era mosque in Chattogram's old city, associated with Shaista Khan's period.
description: Anderkillah Shahi Jame Mosque is an active 17th-century historic mosque in old Chattogram, built during the Mughal period after the Mughal conquest of Chittagong.

routeMap.fromChattogram: Travel to the Anderkillah or Chawkbazar old-city area by bus, CNG, rickshaw or ride-share.
routeMap.distance: About 2-4 km from Chattogram Railway Station

howToGo: Reach Anderkillah in the old city, dress modestly, avoid congregational prayer time and seek permission before indoor photography.

reviews.author: Mahin I.
reviews.comment: A meaningful historic landmark in the heart of the old city.

safetyTips: Keep pathways clear and ask before photography.

name: Moheskhali Adinath Temple
shortDescription: A revered Hindu temple on Moinak Hill in Moheshkhali Island, overlooking coastal scenery.
description: Adinath Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva on Moinak Hill in Moheshkhali Island, Cox's Bazar District. It is an important pilgrimage site and is associated with the annual Adinath fair.

routeMap.fromChattogram: Travel first to Cox's Bazar by coach or train, then confirm the currently operating ferry, boat or road connection to Moheshkhali and continue by local transport.
routeMap.distance: About 150 km to Cox's Bazar, then onward to Moheshkhali
routeMap.travelTime: Allow a full day from Cox's Bazar

howToGo: Reach Cox's Bazar first, verify the safest currently running Moheshkhali connection, then use local transport to the temple approach and climb carefully.

reviews.author: Priya D.
reviews.comment: A peaceful hilltop temple with an interesting island journey.

safetyTips: Check weather and boat conditions before crossing.
Respect temple customs and keep the hill path clean.
